rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in visible ICM/TE detail from this somewhat soft-focus single frame and does not critically address whether the image itself clearly supports 3AA.
Thoroughly integrates age, AMH, BMI, ovarian response, male factor, endometrium, first-cycle status, and lifestyle factors with embryo quality and prognosis.

Reasoning is logical and internally consistent overall, with a sensible link from embryo quality and patient factors to prognosis; only minor overinterpretation of morphology and modest speculation about sperm DNA damage.

Recommendations are broadly consistent with IVF practice and Gardner grading context, including single embryo transfer and protocol review, though some lifestyle comments and protocol suggestions are somewhat generic rather than tightly guideline-based.

Provides clear practical next steps for transfer and future cycle planning, including SET, luteal support, lifestyle optimization, and stimulation review, though recommendations are not highly individualized beyond standard practice.
